title: Two Roadside Bombs Kill at Least 7 in Bannu, KP
detail: Two successive roadside IEDs struck Bannu district, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa on June 20, 2026, killing at least seven people. The first bomb hit a passenger pickup truck; the second detonated as rescuers and the injured were being evacuated — a secondary-device tactic consistent with TTP-linked cells active in the area. No group claimed responsibility.

sources.name: Al Jazeera — Two roadside bombs kill at least seven in northwestern Pakistan

media.caption: A double roadside-bomb attack in Bannu killed at least seven people.

title: 517 Afghan Families Registered Crossing Border in Single Day
detail: The Taliban's Commission for Addressing Returnees' Issues registered 517 families (2,719 individuals) entering Afghanistan via the Torkham, Spin Boldak, and Silk Bridge crossings on June 20, 2026, with the largest share — 388 families (2,064 people) — crossing at Torkham. The figure reflects the continued high tempo of returns/deportations from Pakistan and Iran that has strained Afghanistan's reception capacity through the year.

sources.name: KabulNow — Taliban: More than 2,700 returnees registered through major border crossings in one day

media.caption: 517 Afghan families were registered crossing back into Afghanistan in a single day via Torkham, Spin Boldak and Silk Bridge.
